description: Live DNS lookup for A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA and SOA records of a public domain. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.
